{call sp_restore_book(#{delId, jdbcType=INTEGER})}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_bookstore_item_del (log_type, logged_by, item_id, bcode, content_id, book_title, author, publisher, image_url, center_code, qty, loaned_qty, lost_qty) SELECT 'DELETE', #{deletedBy}, item_id, bcode, content_id, book_title, author, publisher, image_url, center_code, qty, loaned_qty, lost_qty FROM erp_bookstore_item WHERE bcode = #{bcode} AND center_code = #{centerCode}

INSERT INTO erp_bookstore_item_del (log_type, logged_by, item_id, bcode, content_id, book_title, author, publisher, image_url, center_code, qty, loaned_qty, lost_qty) SELECT 'UPDATE', #{updatedBy}, item_id, bcode, content_id, book_title, author, publisher, image_url, center_code, qty, loaned_qty, lost_qty FROM erp_bookstore_item WHERE bcode = #{bcode}

INSERT INTO erp_bookstore_content_del (log_type, logged_by, content_id, original_title, author, genre, content_type, schoolyear, summary, keywords, state, publisher, image_url, reading_time, difficulty) SELECT 'UPDATE', #{updatedBy}, content_id, original_title, author, genre, content_type, schoolyear, summary, keywords, state, publisher, image_url, reading_time, difficulty FROM erp_bookstore_content WHERE content_id = #{contentId}

INSERT INTO erp_bookstore_content_detail_del (log_type, logged_by, content_id, gubun, name) SELECT 'UPDATE', #{updatedBy}, content_id, gubun, name FROM erp_bookstore_content_detail WHERE content_id = #{contentId}

INSERT INTO erp_bookstore_item (bcode, content_id, center_code, book_title, author, publisher, image_url, qty, loaned_qty, lost_qty) SELECT d.bcode, d.content_id, d.center_code, d.book_title, d.author, d.publisher, d.image_url, ISNULL(d.qty, 0), ISNULL(d.loaned_qty, 0), ISNULL(d.lost_qty, 0) FROM erp_bookstore_item_del d WHERE d.log_id = #{delId} AND d.center_code IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erp_bookstore_item i WHERE i.bcode = d.bcode AND i.center_code = d.center_code)
mapper.select:
SELECT bc.content_id AS contentId, bc.original_title AS originalTitle, bc.author AS author, bc.genre AS genre, g.codeNm AS genreName, bc.content_type AS contentType, ct.codeNm AS contentTypeName, bc.schoolyear AS schoolyear, s.codeNm AS schoolyearName, bc.summary AS summary, bc.keywords AS keywords, bc.state AS state, bc.publisher AS publisher, bc.image_url AS imageUrl, bc.reading_time AS readingTime, bc.difficulty AS difficulty, COALESCE(da.name, dr.name, dc.name) AS extraDetailName FROM erp_bookstore_content bc LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_code g ON g.gubun = 'G' AND g.code = bc.genre LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_code s ON s.gubun = 'S' AND s.code = bc.schoolyear LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_code ct ON ct.gubun = 'C' AND ct.code = bc.content_type LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_content_detail da ON da.content_id = bc.content_id AND da.gubun = 'A' LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_content_detail dr ON dr.content_id = bc.content_id AND dr.gubun = 'R' LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_content_detail dc ON dc.content_id = bc.content_id AND dc.gubun = 'C'
AND bc.original_title LIKE '%' + #{title} + '%' AND bc.author LIKE '%' + #{author} + '%' AND bc.genre = #{genre} AND bc.schoolyear = #{schoolYear} AND bc.keywords LIKE '%' + #{keyword} + '%' AND bc.content_type = #{contentType} AND bc.state = #{state}
SELECT TOP 1 content_id FROM erp_bookstore_content WHERE original_title = #{title}

SELECT TOP 1 item_id AS itemId, bcode AS bcode, content_id AS contentId, book_title AS bookTitle, author AS author, publisher AS publisher, image_url AS imageUrl, center_code AS centerCode, qty AS qty, loaned_qty AS loanedQty, lost_qty AS lostQty FROM erp_bookstore_item WHERE bcode = #{bcode}

SELECT item_id AS itemId, bcode AS bcode, content_id AS contentId, book_title AS bookTitle, author AS author, publisher AS publisher, image_url AS imageUrl, center_code AS centerCode, qty AS qty, loaned_qty AS loanedQty, lost_qty AS lostQty FROM erp_bookstore_item
AND content_id = #{contentId} AND publisher LIKE '%' + #{publisher} + '%'
SELECT ISNULL((SELECT qty FROM erp_bookstore_item WHERE bcode = #{bcode} AND center_code = #{centerCode}), 0)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM erp_bookstore_item WHERE bcode = #{bcode} AND center_code = #{centerCode}
mapper.select: SELECT d.log_id AS delId, d.logged_at AS deletedAt, d.logged_by AS deletedBy, d.item_id AS itemId, d.bcode AS bcode, d.content_id AS contentId, d.book_title AS bookTitle, d.author AS author, d.publisher AS publisher, d.image_url AS imageUrl, d.center_code AS centerCode, d.qty AS qty, d.loaned_qty AS loanedQty, d.lost_qty AS lostQty FROM ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bcode, center_code ORDER BY log_id DESC) AS rn FROM erp_bookstore_item_del ) d WHERE d.rn = 1 AND d.log_type = 'DELETE' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erp_bookstore_item i WHERE i.bcode = d.bcode AND i.center_code = d.center_code) ORDER BY d.logged_at DESC

SELECT bcode AS bcode, center_code AS centerCode, qty AS quantity, loaned_qty AS loanedQty, lost_qty AS lostQty, CASE WHEN qty - loaned_qty - lost_qty > 0 THEN 'AVAILABLE' WHEN loaned_qty > 0 THEN 'LOANED' WHEN lost_qty > 0 THEN 'LOST' ELSE 'AVAILABLE' END AS state, registered_at AS registeredAt, content_id AS contentId, book_title AS bookTitle, author AS author, publisher AS publisher, image_url AS imageUrl FROM erp_bookstore_item WHERE center_code = #{centerCode} ORDER BY registered_at DESC

SELECT d.log_id AS delId, d.logged_at AS deletedAt, d.logged_by AS deletedBy, d.content_id AS contentId, d.original_title AS originalTitle, d.author AS author, d.genre AS genre, d.content_type AS contentType, d.schoolyear AS schoolyear, d.summary AS summary, d.keywords AS keywords FROM ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY content_id ORDER BY log_id DESC) AS rn FROM erp_bookstore_content_del ) d WHERE d.rn = 1 AND d.log_type = 'DELETE' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erp_bookstore_content c WHERE c.content_id = d.content_id) ORDER BY d.logged_at DESC
UPDATE TOP (1) erp_bookstore_item SET loaned_qty = loaned_qty + 1 OUTPUT INSERTED.item_id WHERE bcode = #{bcode} AND center_code = #{centerCode} AND qty - loaned_qty - lost_qty > 0
UPDATE TOP (1) erp_bookstore_item SET loaned_qty = loaned_qty + 1 OUTPUT INSERTED.item_id WHERE content_id = #{contentId} AND center_code = #{centerCode} AND qty - loaned_qty - lost_qty > 0
mapper.update: UPDATE erp_bookstore_item SET loaned_qty = loaned_qty - 1 WHERE item_id = #{itemId} AND loaned_qty > 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_bookstore_item_loan (item_id, student_id, status) VALUES (#{itemId}, #{studentId}, 'LOANED')
mapper.update: UPDATE erp_bookstore_item_loan SET status = 'RETURNED', returned_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE loan_id = #{loanId} AND status = 'LOANED'
mapper.select: SELECT l.loan_id AS loanId, l.item_id AS itemId, i.bcode AS bcode, i.center_code AS centerCode, l.student_id AS studentId, l.loaned_at AS loanedAt, l.returned_at AS returnedAt, l.status AS status FROM erp_bookstore_item_loan l JOIN erp_bookstore_item i ON i.item_id = l.item_id WHERE l.loan_id = #{loanId}

SELECT l.loan_id AS loanId, l.item_id AS itemId, i.bcode AS bcode, i.center_code AS centerCode, l.student_id AS studentId, s.student_name AS studentName, l.loaned_at AS loanedAt, l.returned_at AS returnedAt, l.status AS status FROM erp_bookstore_item_loan l JOIN erp_bookstore_item i ON i.item_id = l.item_id LEFT JOIN erp_student s ON s.student_id = l.student_id WHERE i.bcode = #{bcode} AND i.center_code = #{centerCode} AND l.status = 'LOANED' ORDER BY l.loaned_at DESC

SELECT TOP 1 l.loan_id AS loanId, l.item_id AS itemId, i.bcode AS bcode, i.center_code AS centerCode, l.student_id AS studentId, l.loaned_at AS loanedAt, l.returned_at AS returnedAt, l.status AS status FROM erp_bookstore_item_loan l JOIN erp_bookstore_item i ON i.item_id = l.item_id WHERE l.student_id = #{studentId} AND l.status = 'LOANED' ORDER BY l.loaned_at DESC

SELECT bc.content_id AS contentId, bc.original_title AS originalTitle, bc.image_url AS imageUrl, bc.schoolyear AS schoolyear, s.codeNm AS schoolyearName, ct.codeNm AS contentTypeName, g.codeNm AS genreName, bc.difficulty AS difficulty, ISNULL(q.qty, 0) AS quantity, ISNULL(q.loanedQty, 0) AS loanedQty, lg.lastChangedAt AS lastChangedAt FROM erp_bookstore_content bc LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_code s ON s.gubun = 'S' AND s.code = bc.schoolyear LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_code ct ON ct.gubun = 'C' AND ct.code = bc.content_type LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_code g ON g.gubun = 'G' AND g.code = bc.genre LEFT JOIN ( SELECT content_id, SUM(qty) AS qty, SUM(loaned_qty) AS loanedQty FROM erp_bookstore_item WHERE center_code = #{centerCode} GROUP BY content_id ) q ON q.content_id = bc.content_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT content_id, MAX(changed_at) AS lastChangedAt FROM erp_bookstore_item_stock_log WHERE center_code = #{centerCode} GROUP BY content_id ) lg ON lg.content_id = bc.content_id
AND ISNULL(bc.state, 'Y') = 'Y' AND bc.schoolyear = #{schoolYear} AND bc.content_type = #{contentType} AND bc.genre = #{genre} AND bc.original_title LIKE '%' + #{title} + '%' AND ISNULL(q.qty, 0) > 0 AND ISNULL(q.qty, 0) = 0
ORDER BY bc.schoolyear, bc.original_title
SELECT ISNULL(SUM(qty), 0) FROM erp_bookstore_item WHERE content_id = #{contentId} AND center_code = #{centerCode}

SELECT item_id AS itemId, bcode AS bcode, book_title AS bookTitle, author AS author, publisher AS publisher, image_url AS imageUrl, qty AS qty, loaned_qty AS loanedQty, lost_qty AS lostQty, registered_at AS registeredAt FROM erp_bookstore_item WHERE content_id = #{contentId} AND center_code = #{centerCode} ORDER BY registered_at DESC, item_id DESC
SELECT ISNULL((SELECT loaned_qty FROM erp_bookstore_item WHERE bcode = #{bcode} AND center_code = #{centerCode}), 0)
SELECT ISNULL(SUM(loaned_qty), 0) FROM erp_bookstore_item WHERE content_id = #{contentId} AND center_code = #{centerCode}
SELECT TOP 1 bcode FROM erp_bookstore_item WHERE content_id = #{contentId} ORDER BY item_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_bookstore_item_stock_log (content_id, center_code, before_qty, after_qty, memo, changed_by) VALUES (#{contentId}, #{centerCode}, #{beforeQty}, #{afterQty}, #{memo}, #{changedBy})
mapper.select: SELECT log_id AS logId, before_qty AS beforeQty, after_qty AS afterQty, memo AS memo, changed_by AS changedBy, changed_at AS changedAt FROM erp_bookstore_item_stock_log WHERE content_id = #{contentId} AND center_code = #{centerCode} ORDER BY log_id DESC
